questions.text: Describe a photograph that you like.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a photograph that you like. You should say: what is in the photograph; who took it; where you keep it; and explain why you like this photograph.

questions.text: Do other people in your family like this photograph too?
questions.say: Thank you. Do other people in your family like this photograph too?

questions.text: Why do people take so many photos nowadays?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a photograph you like, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all photography. Why do people take so many photos nowadays?

questions.text: Is photography a form of art?
